ztb.risk.advanced_auto_stop module

Advanced Auto-Stop System for Live Trading.

Implements sophisticated risk management with multiple stop mechanisms: - Volatility-based stops - Drawdown-based stops - Time-based stops - Performance-based stops - Market condition-based stops

Bases: Enum

ztb.risk.circuit_breakers module

Circuit breakers and kill switches for risk management.

This module provides emergency shutdown mechanisms and circuit breaker patterns to protect against cascading failures and maintain system stability.
